ValidationRule.description: SFM-12992: What Functionality? is required when selecting 1 or more ‘More Functionality' values in the Desired Features field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.skipValidation) ,RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SWAT' ,ISBLANK(What_functionality__c) ,ISCHANGED(Desired_Features__c) ,OR( INCLUDES(Desired_Features__c, 'More WIV Functionality') ,INCLUDES(Desired_Features__c, 'More Online Scheduling Functionality') ,INCLUDES(Desired_Features__c, 'More Forms Functionality') ,INCLUDES(Desired_Features__c, 'More Analytics Functionality') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot leave the What Functionality? field blank
